accepted.text: Sara has worked there since April, and she has learned how to prepare the soil, choose seeds, and water young plants.
She has never grown tomatoes before, so she asks the older gardeners many questions.
Today, the class has finished its first garden bed.
Sara has planted twelve small flowers near the gate, and her friend Noah has labeled the seed trays.
The rain has stopped, so the children have gone outside to check the soil.
Their teacher has brought a watering can, but the ground is still wet.
The group has built a wooden bench beside the path.
They have used old boards from the school workshop, and the bench has become a favorite place to rest.
Sara has just painted it green.
She has already cleaned her brushes, but she has not put them away yet.
